case_parameter_rules.gi_bleed: neutral defaults, as in P2C: not mapped from the bank cases and not calibrated; a shadow baseline, which the migration gate (P2E-6) blocks

D: guard only; a debt is never negative (P2E-2)
G: guard only; no module writes G yet
L: guard only; only the core's congestion and clearance write L yet
N: guard only; no module writes N yet
V: guard only, in mL-eq of circulating volume (applied to V scaled by kappa, so it never separates kappa from the curve scale); the family engine's circulation clamp [.25, 1.9] is deliberately not adopted
W: guard only; no module writes W yet
k: guard only; no module writes K yet

KD-S1: REVISE CORE: D with memory produces lactate; RR from W plus a saturating metabolic drive
KD-S2: ADOPT CORE DIRECTION: HR from R plus one common sympathetic drive plus modulators
KD-S3: RESOLVED, not changed in P2C: physiology reads the unrounded state; display and gating read Observation v2
KD-S4: REVISE CORE: one smooth, saturating preload curve; no clamp
P2E-2: STRUCTURE: D integrates the delivery deficit below metabolic demand, never a credit; demand multipliers and the arrival references are TBD
P2I-2T: STRUCTURE: one haemorrhage source drives circulating volume and red-cell mass; Hb is a concentration; refill, crystalloid and red cells act through the shared state; every value is TBD

KD-S1: lactate and respiratory rate (approved revision, P2C-1): the core accumulates an oxygen-delivery debt D (tau provisional), produces lactate from D and clears it with its own memory, and reads RR as ventilation (W) plus a saturating metabolic drive anchored to arrival, so clearing lactate never causes bradypnoea; the family engine sets both instantly from circulation, with an RR floor of 14 in this family
TBD: tau_D, D->lactate gain, lactate clearance, metabolic drive gain, RR bounds
KD-S2: heart rate (adopted direction, P2C-2): the core reads sinus rate as the intrinsic rate plus the chronotropic response to one common sympathetic drive, blunted by beta-blockade; the drive answers to the pressure deficit, the oxygen-delivery debt D, hypoxaemia and hypoglycaemia, rises at once and decays with its own memory, and no disease module writes it, so hemostasis lowers the rate only through recovered pressure and repaid debt; the family engine sets HR instantly from circulation and subtracts 20 bpm x hemostasis_relief from the displayed HR (a module writing an observable, which §8.1 rules out)
TBD: pressure/output deficit and D gains, hypoxaemia and hypoglycaemia gains and thresholds, sympathetic decay time
KD-S3: consciousness at the 80 mmHg threshold: the family engine compares the rounded SBP (80), the core the raw value (79.9)
Observation v2 (Phase 1): thresholds on raw state or on the displayed value
KD-S4: volume, pressure and refill (approved revision, P2C-3): the core reads output from one smooth, saturating preload curve (V -> effective preload -> stroke volume -> output -> pressure), concave everywhere, with arrival placed on it by a case position (provisional default 0.5, where its slope equals the family engine's linear gain) and output lowered by tone above arrival; the family engine is linear in volume and clamps circulation to [.25, 1.9] (+625 mL-eq). So pressure, refill and the rate differ wherever V leaves arrival: a little below it (the curve is steeper there), more above it (the curve saturates), and past the clamp the core's V keeps rising while its output barely moves
TBD: curve form and scale, arrival position, P sensitivity, afterload sensitivity, congestion knee and gain
P2E-2: oxygen debt against demand (structure approved, P2E-2): D integrates max(0, demand - delivery), so delivery above demand is no credit and D repays only what it accrued. With the GI defaults unmapped (demand baseline 1, no clearable arrival lactate), a run whose delivery rises above arrival keeps lactate at arrival instead of clearing it below, and RR and the drive follow; the family engine lowers lactate below arrival as soon as circulation improves
TBD: demand baseline and modifiers, oxygen-delivery normalization, the GI family's arrival references (P2E-6 migration gate)
P2I-2T: shared haemorrhage state (faculty decision, P2I-2T): one bleeding source takes whole blood -- circulating volume and red cells together -- out of a shared blood state; plasma refill restores part of the shed volume without red cells; crystalloid and packed red cells act through the same state; Hb is red-cell content over circulating volume, and V is kappa x the circulating-volume deviation. The family engine moves circulation and Hb by two independent drifts, dilutes Hb by a fixed amount per mL of crystalloid that never reverses and raises it by a fixed 0.85 g/dL per unit. So V differs wherever refill acts (every bleeding run) and Hb wherever blood is lost, refilled, diluted or transfused, and both reach output, delivery, D, lactate, RR and HR

TBD: bleed rate (case or family), arrival circulating volume, kappa (only kappa / curve scale is identifiable), refill target, capacity and tau, red-cell unit content and volume, crystalloid retention and redistribution

afterload_sensitivity: how much tone above arrival lowers output, 1 / (1 + a (T - 1)): TBD (KD-S4)
arrival_circulating_volume_ml: SYNTHETIC/CANDIDATE normalization of the shared blood state (P2I-2T): the circulating volume at arrival, in mL-equivalent, against which red-cell content and haemoglobin are read. Not a measured litre and not inferred from the arrival Hb: TBD
arrival_preload_fraction: where arrival sits on the preload curve when the case does not declare it (0 empty, 1 plateau): TBD (KD-S4)
collapse_burden_limit: burden (fraction below the threshold x minutes) at which R moves to a pulseless rhythm (P2E-3): TBD; off by default
collapse_burden_per_minute: collapse burden accrued per minute at full severity (P2F-7): 1 by construction so far: TBD
collapse_output_threshold: output_rel below which the collapse burden accrues (P2E-3): TBD; off (None) by default, synthetic values in tests only
collapse_repayment_tau_min: repayment of the burden once output recovers (P2E-3): TBD; None holds the burden
collapse_terminal_rhythm: the pulseless rhythm the collapse rule ends in (P2E-3): the selection rule is TBD
congestion_per_excess_preload: L per minute at full excess and no pump reserve: TBD (KD-S4)
congestion_preload_knee: position on the preload curve above which excess preload congests a pump without reserve: TBD (KD-S4)
debt_clearance_tau_min: tau_D_recovery: TBD (KD-S1); 60 min is not approved. D repays only what it accrued: the deficit against demand is never a credit (P2E-2)
debt_per_delivery_deficit: D accrued per unit of delivery deficit per minute (P2F-7): 1 by construction so far; only its product with the D -> lactate gain shows in lactate: TBD
hr_per_sympathetic_drive: family_engine._surface: hr + (circulation - 1) * 25, read here as bpm per unit of sympathetic drive
hypoglycaemia_threshold_mg_dl: glucose below which it drives the rate: TBD (KD-S2)
hypoxaemia_threshold_spo2: SpO2 below which hypoxaemia drives the rate: TBD (KD-S2)
lactate_drive_threshold_mmol_l: lactate above which acidaemia drives breathing: TBD (KD-S1)
lactate_per_output_deficit: family_engine._diagnostic: lactate + (circulation - 1) * 2, reached here as the steady state of D and of lactate kinetics; the D -> lactate production gain it implies is provisional (KD-S1)
low_output_pressure_knee: pressure_rel below which SBP and DBP leave the adopted linear relation and fall continuously to 0 with output (P2E-4): TBD
lung_water_clearance_tau_min: slow clearance of lung water above arrival: TBD (P2D-6)
oxygen_extraction_reserve: maximal over normal oxygen extraction, E_max / E_normal (P2I-2P): consumption stays supply-independent down to the critical delivery demand / reserve, and only the demand left unmet below it is a deficit D integrates. 1 is the pre-P2I-2P model kept as the neutral default (no reserve: any delivery below demand is a deficit), not a physiological value; the value above 1 is TBD. Only reserve x arrival_delivery_ratio reaches D: a reserve r keeps today's GI dynamics only with the arrival band read as ratio / r, a joint faculty decision
plasma_refill_capacity_ml: SYNTHETIC/CANDIDATE finite interstitial reserve: the most plasma refill can add in an encounter (P2I-2T): TBD
plasma_refill_target_share: SYNTHETIC/CANDIDATE share of the shed volume plasma refill restores at most (P2I-2T), and only while the circulation is below arrival; refill carries no red cells: TBD
plasma_refill_tau_min: SYNTHETIC/CANDIDATE time constant of plasma refill toward its target (P2I-2T): TBD
preload_curve_scale_ml: scale of the saturating preload curve 1 - exp(-x / scale): TBD (KD-S4). Its value keeps, at the default arrival position 0.5, the family engine's slope at arrival: 300 mL per red-cell unit / 0.36 circulation per unit (family_engine.TRANSFUSION note; _minute)
pressure_levels: family_engine._PRESSURE_LEVELS, without the DC1 anchoring or the recovery margin, which belong to the observation layer
pump_preload_coupling: how far a depressed pump shrinks the preload curve: scale x P^c, so it lowers and flattens the usable curve (c = 0: P only scales output): TBD (P2D-5)
rr_max: safety bound on RR, not physiology: TBD (KD-S1)
rr_metabolic_max: largest metabolic addition to RR (saturation): TBD (KD-S1)
rr_per_lactate: metabolic drive -> RR gain at the threshold: TBD (KD-S1); the value is the legacy GI RR gain 15 per circulation unit / lactate 2 per unit
rr_ventilatory_floor: RR below which the arrival RR is never read as metabolic: TBD (KD-S1)
sympathetic_decay_tau_min: sympathetic decay time: TBD (KD-S2); the drive rises at once
sympathetic_per_debt: oxygen-delivery debt (D / tau_D) -> sympathetic drive gain: TBD (KD-S2)
sympathetic_per_hypoglycaemia_mg_dl: drive per mg/dL below the threshold: TBD (KD-S2)
sympathetic_per_hypoxaemia_point: drive per SpO2 point below the threshold: TBD (KD-S2)
sympathetic_per_pressure_deficit: MAP/output deficit -> sympathetic drive gain: TBD (KD-S2)
volume_preload_kappa: SYNTHETIC/CANDIDATE conversion V = kappa x circulating-volume deviation (P2I-2T). Output reads V only as V / preload_curve_scale_ml, so only kappa / scale is identifiable from the haemodynamics: neither is approved alone. 1 keeps V in mL-equivalent of circulating volume: TBD
